objective: Aislar el primer día que bloqueó el backfill ORIGEN después del 22/07/2022 e identificar valores/tipos problemáticos de Comanda_Pago sin modificar datos.

queries.name: origen_2022_07_23_payment_sample
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) CONVERT(varchar(64),v.Vn_Folio) AS folio,CONVERT(varchar(64),v.Vn_Documento) AS documento,CONVERT(varchar(40),cp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago) AS codigo,fp.Fp_Descripcion AS forma,cp.Cp_Importe,cp.Cp_Propina,cp.Cp_Referencia,SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(CAST(cp.Cp_Referencia AS sql_variant),'BaseType') AS referencia_tipo,v.Vn_Fecha FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento LEFT JOIN Forma_Pago fp WITH (NOLOCK) ON fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago=cp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)='2022-07-23' AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'')<>'CA' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0 ORDER BY v.Vn_Folio

queries.name: origen_2022_07_23_counts
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pagos,COUNT(DISTINCT v.Vn_Folio) AS tickets,CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe,CAST(SUM(ISNULL(cp.Cp_Propina,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)='2022-07-23' AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'')<>'CA' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0
